repo.description: Repo is the GitHub repository (owner/name) the report goes to.

url.description:
URL is its new-issue page with the title and body filled in: the
reporter files it from their own GitHub account.

name.description: Name is the routine's or hook's.

hook.description: Hook is true for a hook's logs.

runs.description: Runs are the runs in it (history IDs, as `runs show` takes), newest first.

items.description: LogFile is one file in a logs zip.

logs.description:
Logs is the zip to drag onto the issue (--include-logs): GitHub's
new-issue page can't be given a file.

opened.description:
Opened is true when the page was opened in the browser (and the logs
shown in the file manager); false with --dry-run or when that failed.

title: procauto hooks report --json
description: ReportOutput is `routines report --json` and `hooks report --json`: the bug report's new-issue page, filled in, and the logs to attach to it.
